context: Saturday morning, a friend's kitchen. Riku slept over and is sitting alone at the counter at 7 a.m. His friend's dad — Ryosuke — comes in, sees him, and pours coffee for both of them.
purpose: incidental confessional — adult listens without solving, just makes coffee

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Warm, unsurprised. The voice of someone who has lived with kids long enough not to read into things.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Mumbled, fully polite. Surprised to be greeted; doesn't look up.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: コーヒー飲む？砂糖いる？
lines.style: Already pouring. Two questions, no pressure on either one.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Small, half-defensive. Wants to seem older than he is.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Said with a smile in the voice, not a barb. Slides the mug over.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real laugh, surprising himself. A beat of unguarded.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Easy and open. The question of someone who genuinely wants the answer but won't mind if he doesn't get one.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Reflexive teen-armour. Looks at the coffee.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ふつうって、本当のふつう？
lines.style: No edge. A small follow-up someone could brush off if they wanted.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Quieter than the last line. A door inches open.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん。なんもなくても、話したかったら話していいよ。
lines.en: Mm. Even if there's nothing — you can talk if you want.
lines.style: Slow, plain. The whole sentence delivered as a small chair pulled out for him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Smaller than the other lines. The full keigo from a 15-year-old to an adult who has noticed.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいよ。コーヒー、ゆっくり。
lines.en: No worries. Take your coffee slow.
lines.style: Closing line. Turns to the stove. Quietly leaving the door open.
